DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お借りした物をなくされたとのことですね。どんな物で、どなたから借りたのか伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You lost something you borrowed. Could you tell me what it was and who lent it to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚から借りた双眼鏡です。海を見に行った帰りに、肩に掛けていたはずの双眼鏡がないことに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚から借りた双眼鏡が海見物帰りに肩からなくなったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Binoculars borrowed from a colleague. On my way back from looking at the sea, I noticed they were no longer hanging from my shoulder as they should have been.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that binoculars borrowed from a colleague disappeared from your shoulder on the way back from viewing the sea. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借りた物だと分かるよう記録します。海を見ていた場所で、外して置いた覚えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will record that they were borrowed. Do you remember taking them off and putting them down where you watched the sea?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 岩場には置いていません。帰りに休んだ屋根付きのベンチで、ひもを肩から外したと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 岩場には置かず帰路の屋根付きベンチで肩ひもを外した可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not put them on the rocks. I think I took the strap off my shoulder at a covered bench where I rested on the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you did not leave them on the rocks and may have removed the shoulder strap at a covered bench on the return journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本体やひもに特徴はありますか。製品番号など、持ち主に確認できるものもあれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there distinguishing features on the body or strap? Please also tell us anything you can check with the owner, such as a product number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本体は濃い緑で、ひもに黄色いテープが付いています。製品番号は見ていないので、今は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 濃緑の本体とひもの黄色テープを説明し製品番号は不明と明確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The body is dark green, and yellow tape is on the strap. I have not seen the product number, so I do not know it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the dark-green body and yellow tape on the strap, clearly stating the product number is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない番号は推測しなくて大丈夫です。持ち主には、紛失したことをすでに伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is no need to guess a number you do not know. Have you already told the owner you lost them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡しましたが、まだ返事がありません。返事が来たら製品番号を聞きたいです。届いた物の確認には持ち主も来た方がいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち主へ連絡済みで返信待ちと伝え番号を聞く予定と受取確認に同行が要るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I contacted them but have no reply yet. When they reply, I want to ask the product number. Should the owner also come to identify any binoculars handed in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you contacted the owner and await a reply, plan to ask the number, and ask whether they must accompany you for identification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認方法は物が届いた時点でご案内します。まずあなたの連絡先と、持ち主へ追加の特徴を確認できることを記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain identification when the item is handed in. First I will record your contact details and that you can ask the owner for additional features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号に連絡してください。私は借りた本人で、持ち主ではありません。番号や追加の特徴が分かったら、届け出の内容を補足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 借りた本人で所有者ではないと確認し連絡番号と判明した特徴を追加連絡する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please contact me at this number. I am the borrower, not the owner. When I learn the number or more features, I will add them to the report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you are the borrower, not the owner, and give a contact number and a plan to report further identifying details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 借りた方としてのお届けを受け付けました。新しい情報が分かったらご連絡ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have accepted your report as the borrower. Please contact us when you have new information. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。配達の時間帯について何かご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Do you have a preference about the delivery time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤明けに寝ていて気づきませんでした。また同じ時間に来るなら、隣の人へ渡してもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤明けの睡眠で配達に気づかなかったと説明し同時間なら隣人へ渡せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was asleep after a night shift and did not notice. If they come at the same time again, can they leave it with my neighbor?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you missed the delivery while sleeping after a night shift and ask about giving it to a neighbor at that time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お隣へのお渡しを、この票だけで決めることはできません。ご本人が受け取れる方法を確認しましょう。窓口へ来る方がご都合よいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot decide to hand it to a neighbor based on this slip alone. Let us check a way for you to receive it yourself. Would coming to a counter be easier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夕方なら来られます。家は隣と玄関が近いのですが、隣の人にはまだ何も頼んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕方なら本人が来られ玄関は近いが隣人には未依頼と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can come in the evening. Our entrances are close together, but I have not asked the neighbor for anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can come in the evening and the entrances are close, but you have not asked the neighbor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、まずご本人の窓口受け取りを検討しましょう。荷物番号から保管場所を確認します。こちらの票を拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us first consider collection by you at a counter. I will check the storage location from the parcel number. May I see the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どうぞ。この窓口にある荷物だと思って、身分証を持たずに来てしまいました。今日すぐには受け取れないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不在票を示しこの窓口で受け取れると思い身分証なしで来たと伝え当日受取可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I assumed the parcel was at this counter and came without ID. Does that mean I cannot collect it straight away today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the notice, explain you came without ID thinking it was here, and ask about collection today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この荷物は別の保管窓口にあります。受け取りに必要な本人確認書類と、そちらで対応できる時間を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The parcel is at another storage counter. I will check the identification needed and the hours available there before explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、ここで待っていれば運んでもらえるということではないのですね。保管窓口の場所を紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待てば運ばれるのではないと理解し別保管窓口の場所を紙で頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So it does not mean they will bring it if I wait here. Could you write down the storage counter's location?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that waiting will not bring the parcel here and ask for the other counter's location in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、場所をこちらへ記しました。先に本人確認書類を用意し、その窓口の受け取り案内を確認してお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I have written it here. Prepare the identification first, then check that counter's collection guidance before setting out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内を持って一度家へ戻り、必要な書類を準備します。隣の人への配達ではなく、自分で保管窓口へ行く方法で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一度帰宅し必要書類を準備して隣人配達ではなく本人窓口受取を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take this information home and prepare the documents. I will check how to collect it myself at the storage counter, rather than having it delivered to my neighbor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return home, prepare the documents, and check personal counter collection rather than neighbor delivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不在票もお返しします。場所と必要書類を確認してからお出かけください。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your notice back too. Check the location and documents before going. Thank you for consulting us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 財布の中のカードについてお急ぎのご相談ですね。こちらの銀行のカードは入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You need urgent advice about cards in your wallet. Was a card from this bank inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、キャッシュカードが一枚と、別の会社のクレジットカードが入っています。ここで二枚とも止められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布に銀行キャッシュカードと別会社クレジットカードがあり両方を銀行で止められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, one cash card and a credit card from another company. Can you block both here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the wallet contains this bank's cash card and another company's credit card, and ask whether both can be blocked here. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行のキャッシュカードの停止を承ります。別会社のクレジットカードは、その発行会社へ連絡が必要です。まず本人確認を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can accept a block on our cash card. You need to contact the issuer for the other company's credit card. First let us verify your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚は連絡先が違うのですね。通帳は家にありますが、カードの番号を覚えていません。名前などで確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡先が異なると理解し通帳は家で番号不明でも名前等で確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the two have different contacts. My passbook is at home, and I do not remember the card number. Can you check using my name and other details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show understanding that the contacts differ and ask whether your name can be used when the passbook is at home and number unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カード番号が分からないことも含めて確認します。本人確認ができましたので、当行のキャッシュカードは停止を受け付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check, including that the card number is unknown. We have verified your identity and accepted the block on our cash card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀行の分は止まったのですね。クレジットカードの連絡先を探す途中で、暗証番号を入力する画面が出たので不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀行分の停止を確認し他社の連絡先探索中に暗証番号入力画面が出て不安と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the bank card is blocked. While looking for the credit card contact, a screen asking for my PIN appeared, and I am worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the bank block and say that a PIN-entry screen appeared while searching for the other card's contact, causing concern. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当行では他社カードの停止状況は確認できません。不審な画面へ暗証番号を入れず、発行会社の公式の案内から連絡方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot check the other company's card-block status. Do not enter your PIN on a suspicious screen; check how to contact the issuer through its official guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その画面は閉じます。会社名は分かるので、帰って利用明細に書かれた連絡先も確かめます。今ここでは再発行まで終わったわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面を閉じ会社名と明細の連絡先を確認すると伝え再発行完了ではないか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will close that screen. I know the company name, so I will also check the contact on my statement when I get home. Reissue has not been completed here now, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will close the screen and check the company and statement contact, and confirm that reissue is not complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、今受け付けたのは当行の利用停止です。再発行については別にご案内します。必要書類を確認してから手続きを進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. What we accepted now is blocking our bank's card. Reissue will be explained separately. Let us check the documents needed before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行のカードは停止済み、再発行はこれからと理解しました。他社のカードは私が正規の連絡先を確認して止める相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行停止済み再発行未手続きと整理し他社分は正規の連絡先へ自分で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the bank card is blocked and reissue is still ahead. For the other company's card, I will verify the legitimate contact and discuss blocking it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the completed bank block from pending reissue, and say you will contact the legitimate other issuer yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚の対応を分けて確認できましたね。当行の次の手続きはこちらでご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have distinguished the actions for the two cards. We will explain our next procedure here. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 卵のパックとレシートをお持ちですね。表示について気になる点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an egg carton and receipt. Is there something about the labeling that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きい卵を買ったつもりでしたが、家で見ると小さかったです。今日の売場はＬサイズと書いてあるのに、持っているパックはＭです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きい卵購入のつもりが包装Ｍで今日の棚札はＬと違うことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I bought large eggs, but they looked small at home. Today's shelf says L, but the carton I have is M.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you intended to buy large eggs but the carton is M, unlike today's L shelf label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の売場の札と、昨日お買い求めの商品は分けて確認しましょう。パックの表示とレシートを拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check today's shelf label separately from what you bought yesterday. May I see the carton label and receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。昨日の夕方に買いました。今朝、料理の前に開けかけましたが、卵は一つも出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕方の購入品とレシートを示しふたを開けかけたが卵は未取出しと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I bought them yesterday evening. This morning before cooking, I began opening the carton, but took no eggs out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show yesterday evening's product and receipt, explaining you started opening the lid but removed no eggs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: パックはＭサイズと表示されています。レシートの商品名もＭサイズですね。今日のＬサイズの札だけでは、昨日の売場の状態は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The carton says size M. The receipt's product name is M too. Today's L label alone does not tell us the shelf situation yesterday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日も同じ棚だったので同じ商品だと思いました。買った物はＭだと分かりましたが、今からＬへ替えられるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ棚から同商品と思ったが購入はＭと理解し今からＬ交換できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was the same shelf yesterday, so I thought it was the same product. I understand I bought M, but want to ask if I can exchange them for L now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you assumed the same shelf meant the same product, now understand it was M, and ask about an exchange for L. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食品の交換は開封状態などを担当が確認して判断します。ここではすぐに交換をお約束できません。パックを確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: For food exchanges, staff must check whether it has been opened and other conditions. I cannot promise an immediate exchange here. May I inspect the carton?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、確認してください。ふたの端だけ剥がしているので、未開封とは言えません。卵自体に割れは見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 状態確認に応じふた端を剥がし未開封ではないが卵に割れは見えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I have peeled just the edge of the lid, so it is not unopened. I cannot see any cracks in the eggs themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to inspection, say the lid edge has been peeled and it is not unopened, but no egg cracks are visible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態も担当へ伝えます。まずこちらで確認し、交換できない場合も結果をご説明しますので、お待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the staff about that condition too. We will check here first and explain the result even if exchange is not possible. Could you wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。今日の値札が違うことと、昨日私がＭを買ったことを分けて相談したいです。交換が難しくても、その理由を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待つと答え今日の値札と昨日のＭ購入を分けて相談し不可なら理由を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait. I want to discuss today's different price label separately from my buying M yesterday. Even if exchange is difficult, I will ask the reason.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait, separate today's label from yesterday's M purchase, and ask the reason if exchange is refused. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品とレシートをお預かりしました。担当者の確認後に結果をお伝えします。お持ちくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received the product and receipt. We will tell you the result after staff check. Thank you for bringing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇の方へ進む道を見ていらっしゃいますが、少しお疲れですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the path to the flower beds. Are you a little tired?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連れは花壇へ行きましたが、私はここまでで足が疲れました。追いかけずに休める場所を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 連れは花壇へ行ったが自分は足が疲れ追わず休憩場所を探したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My companion went to the flower beds, but my legs are tired after coming this far. I want somewhere to rest rather than follow them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your companion went to the flower beds but your legs are tired and you want to rest rather than follow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花壇まで行かなくても、この右側の屋根の下にベンチがあります。入口へ戻る道もそこから見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need not go to the flower beds. There are benches under the roof on the right. The route back to the entrance is visible from there too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 屋根の下なら助かります。ただ、連れには花壇の入口で待つと言ってしまったので、そのベンチを見つけられるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根下を希望し連れへ花壇入口で待つと伝えたため新しい場所を見つけられるか心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: A roof would help. But I told my companion I would wait at the flower-bed entrance, so I worry whether they can find that bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you prefer the shelter but worry your companion will find the new place because you said the flower-bed entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休む場所が変わったと連絡できるなら、入口の案内図の横にある屋根と伝えてください。花壇の入口とは別の場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you can contact them about the change, say the roof beside the entrance map. It is different from the flower-bed entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話でそう伝えます。ベンチまで行く途中で階段を下りる必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新待機場所を電話で伝えると答えベンチまで階段を下りる必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell them by phone. Do I need to go down any stairs on the way to the bench?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will call about the new waiting place and ask whether reaching the bench requires descending stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 階段はありません。案内図の右を回ると、平らな通路で屋根の下へ行けます。通路を横切る自転車にはご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are no stairs. Go around the right side of the map and a level passage leads under the roof. Watch for bicycles crossing the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこへ行って休みます。連れと合流して帰るときは、花壇を通らず今見えている入口へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 屋根下で休むと決め合流後に花壇を通らず入口へ戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go there and rest. When I meet my companion and leave, can we return to the entrance visible now without going through the flower beds?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to rest under the roof and ask whether you can return to the entrance after meeting without passing the flower beds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、屋根から案内図の前へ戻ると入口です。花壇へ回る必要はありません。お連れの方にも、帰りはそこで合流するとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, return from the roof to the front of the map and you will be at the entrance. No need to go around the flower beds. Tell your companion you will meet there for the return too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内図横の屋根へ移ったと電話し、帰りもそこで合流すると伝えます。花壇へ無理に行かず、同じ平らな道から入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内図横の屋根へ移ったと連絡し帰りも合流して平らな同じ道から入口へ戻るとまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call to say I moved to the roof beside the map and that we will meet there to leave. I will not force myself to the flower beds; I will take the same level route to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize calling about the roof beside the map, meeting there to leave, and returning on the same level route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ座ってお休みください。お連れの方と会えましたら、急がずお帰りくださいね。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please sit and rest. Once you meet your companion, go home without rushing. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 港からバスをご利用ですね。お泊まりの宿は、どちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are taking a bus from the port. Where are you staying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この予約票にある宿です。入口に整理券と書いてありますが、先に窓口で買っておく物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿の予約票を示し、整理券を窓口で先に買う必要があるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lodging on this reservation slip. The entrance says numbered boarding slip. Is that something to buy at the counter first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the lodging reservation and ask whether a numbered boarding slip must be bought at the counter in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この路線の整理券は、乗るときに車内で取る紙です。乗った場所を示すためのもので、購入する切符ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this route, it is a paper you take inside the bus when boarding. It shows where you boarded; it is not a ticket to buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗った場所を知らせる紙なのですね。宿へ行くときは、どの停留所で降りればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 整理券は乗車場所を示す紙だと確認し、宿へ行く際の降車停留所を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it indicates where I got on. Which stop should I get off at for my lodging?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm it indicates the boarding point and ask the stop for your lodging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内図の浜通りで降りてください。運賃は降りるときに、整理券の番号を表示板で確かめて支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Get off at Hamadori on this map. Pay when you get off, checking the slip's number on the fare display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号と同じ欄を見るということですね。大きい紙幣しか持っていないので、乗る前に小銭を用意したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 整理券と同じ番号の運賃欄を見ると確認し、大きな紙幣しかないので小銭を事前準備すべきか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I look at the fare field with the same number. I have only large banknotes; should I prepare coins before boarding?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm matching the slip number to the fare and ask about preparing coins because you only have large banknotes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、車内で使える紙幣には限りがあります。この窓口では両替できませんので、買い物の際などに小銭をご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, only certain notes can be used on the bus. This counter cannot change money, so please prepare coins when shopping or otherwise.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 売店で飲み物を買って、小銭を用意します。降りるまで整理券をなくさないように、財布に入れておいてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売店で買い物をして小銭を用意すると伝え、降車まで整理券を財布に入れておけるか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy a drink at the shop to get coins. May I keep the slip in my wallet so I do not lose it before getting off?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will get coins through a shop purchase and check whether you can keep the slip in your wallet until alighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 大丈夫です。降りる前に取り出しておくと安心ですね。降車口で慌てないよう、浜通りの放送が聞こえたら準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Taking it out before getting off is reassuring. When you hear the Hamadori announcement, prepare so you do not rush at the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に小銭を用意し、乗るときに整理券を取ります。浜通りの案内が流れたら財布から出して、番号の運賃を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小銭準備、乗車時の整理券取得、浜通りの案内後の取り出しと運賃確認の順序を伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will get coins first and take the slip when boarding. When Hamadori is announced, I will take it out of my wallet and check the fare for its number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain preparing coins, taking the slip on boarding, then taking it out and checking the fare after Hamadori is announced. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順でご利用ください。この案内図もお持ちくださいね。それでは、よいご滞在を。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use it in that order. Take this map too. Have a pleasant stay, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 粗大ごみの回収予定の通知ですね。日付についてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a bulky-waste collection notice. Is your question about the date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知では来週火曜日ですが、日曜から出張です。折り畳み机を、土曜日に外へ出しておいてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 火曜回収の通知だが日曜から出張すると説明し、土曜に折り畳み机を外へ出せるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says next Tuesday, but I leave on business Sunday. Can I put the folding table outside on Saturday?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain Tuesday collection and a business trip from Sunday, and ask about putting the folding table out Saturday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この回収では指定日の朝に出していただきます。土曜日から置いておくことはできません。日程の変更を担当へ確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this collection, put it out on the specified morning. It cannot be left there from Saturday. Shall I ask the staff about changing the date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 変更をお願いします。帰るのは木曜の夜なので、金曜日以降に回収できる日を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更を依頼し、木曜夜に帰るので金曜以降の回収日を知りたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please change it. I return Thursday night, so I want to know a collection date from Friday onward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a change and say you return Thursday night and want collection Friday or later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望を担当に伝えます。今ここでは次の日付を決められません。通知にある受付番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass on your preference. We cannot decide the next date here now. Please give the reception number on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右上のこの番号です。番号の下に書いてある場所は、アパートのごみ置場でしょうか。玄関前ではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知右上の受付番号を示し、回収場所が玄関前ではなく共用ごみ置場か確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This number at the top right. Is the location below it the apartment's shared waste area, not in front of my door?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the top-right reception number and check the collection point is the shared waste area rather than your front door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知には建物共用の回収場所とあります。場所の詳細も担当へ確認しますので、今は机を出さず、室内に置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It says the building's shared collection point. We will also check the exact place with staff, so do not put the table out now; keep it inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 机は室内に置いておきます。出張中でも携帯はつながるので、日程がわかったら電話で知らせてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 机を室内に置くと伝え、出張中も携帯で回収日程の連絡を受けたいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep it indoors. My mobile works during the trip, so could you call me when the schedule is known?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep it inside and ask to receive the collection schedule on your mobile during the trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ご連絡先を申込書で確認します。電話で新しい日付と排出場所の説明を受けてから、出してくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I will confirm your contact in the application. Put it out only after hearing the new date and collection location by phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出張中はこの携帯番号で受けます。日付と場所が決まるまでは外に出さず、今の火曜日の通知も手元に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯で連絡を受け、日付と場所が決まるまで排出せず、現在の通知を保管すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will answer this mobile number while away. Until the date and place are set, I will not put it outside and will keep the current Tuesday notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will receive the call, not put it out until date and place are settled, and retain the current notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。変更希望と場所の確認を担当へ引き継ぎます。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass the change request and location check to the staff. Thank you for consulting us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 声が出しにくそうですね。無理に話さず、この紙に書いていただいても大丈夫ですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: It seems difficult to speak. You do not need to force your voice; you may write on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。昨日の夕方から声がかすれています。ここは初めてで、予約はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日夕方から声がかすれ、初診で予約なしだと筆談で伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. My voice has been hoarse since yesterday evening. This is my first visit and I have no appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Communicate in writing that your voice has been hoarse since yesterday evening, it is your first visit, and you have no appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。声以外に、息苦しさや飲み込みにくさはありますか。短く書いてくだされば大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Apart from your voice, do you have breathing difficulty or trouble swallowing? A short written answer is fine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 息苦しさはありません。水も飲めますが、長く話すと喉がつらいです。受付でも、この紙を使っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 息苦しさはなく水は飲めるが長く話すと喉がつらいと伝え、受付でも紙を使えるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No breathing difficulty. I can drink water, but speaking for long hurts my throat. May I use this paper at reception too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there is no breathing difficulty and you can drink water, but long speech hurts; ask to use the paper at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。症状の紙は私から受付へ渡します。診察の順番を確認しますので、保険の資格が確認できる物をお持ちか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, I will give reception your symptom note. We will check the consultation order, so tell me whether you brought proof of insurance eligibility.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資格が確認できる物は持っています。声で呼ばれても返事ができないかもしれないので、手を上げて知らせてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資格確認の物を持っていると伝え、呼出し時に声の返事の代わりに手を上げてよいか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have proof of eligibility. I may not be able to answer aloud when called; may I raise my hand instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have eligibility proof and confirm raising your hand instead of replying aloud when called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。お名前を呼んだら手を上げてください。受付の近くの椅子にお掛けになると、こちらからも見つけやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Raise your hand when your name is called. Sitting near reception will also make you easier for us to find.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付に近い椅子で待ちます。途中で息が苦しくなったら、紙に書くのを待たずに、近くの職員に合図すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付近くで待つと答え、息苦しくなったら筆談を待たず職員へ合図してよいか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait near reception. If breathing becomes difficult, may I signal a nearby staff member without waiting to write it down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait near reception and check signaling staff immediately rather than writing if breathing becomes difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、すぐに職員を呼ぶか、手を振って知らせてください。状態が変わった場合は、我慢せずにお伝えくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, call a staff member or wave immediately. Do not endure a change in condition without telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な物を受付で見せて、呼ばれたら手を上げます。待っている間に状態が変わったら、すぐ職員に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付で必要物を見せて呼ばれたら手を上げ、状態変化時はすぐ職員に知らせると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show reception what is needed and raise my hand when called. If my condition changes while waiting, I will tell staff immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the required items, raise your hand when called, and report any change immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付には声が出しにくいことも伝えておきます。こちらの椅子でお待ちください。では、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will also tell reception that speaking is difficult. Please wait in this chair. Excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾い物のお届けですね。どちらで見つけられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are handing in a found item. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 港の待合所の外のベンチに、この鍵がありました。座面の真ん中に置いてあって、近くに人はいませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 港の待合所外のベンチ座面の中央に鍵があり、周囲に人がいなかったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This key was on a bench outside the port waiting room. It was in the middle of the seat, and nobody was nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the key was in the middle of a bench seat outside the port waiting room with nobody around. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見つけたのは、何時ごろでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. About what time did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼の十二時十分ごろです。鍵の札に宿の名前らしい文字がありますが、その宿へ届けるほうがよかったですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十二時十分頃に見つけたと伝え、札に宿名らしい文字があるので宿へ届けるべきだったか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around12:10 at midday. The tag has what looks like a lodging name. Should I have taken it there instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found it around12:10 and ask whether it should have gone to the lodging suggested by the tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 札の文字だけでは持ち主はわかりませんので、こちらへ届けていただいて大丈夫です。見つけた場所から、そのまま持っていらしたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The tag alone does not identify the owner, so bringing it here is fine. Did you bring it straight from where you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に待合所の職員へ聞きましたが、誰の物かわからないと言われたので、袋に入れて持ってきました。鍵には何も付け足していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合所職員にも聞いたが不明だったため袋に入れて持参し、鍵には何も付け足していないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I first asked the waiting-room staff, but they did not know the owner, so I put it in a bag and brought it. I added nothing to the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you asked the waiting-room staff without identifying the owner, then brought it in a bag and added nothing to the key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経緯も記録します。ベンチがいくつかありますが、入口に近いほうだったか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that sequence too. There are several benches; do you remember whether it was near the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口から見て右側の二つ目のベンチです。掲示板の横ではなく、飲み物の自動販売機に近いほうでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口から右側二つ目で、掲示板側ではなく飲料自販機近くのベンチと特定する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The second bench on the right when viewed from the entrance. Not beside the noticeboard, but closer to the drinks vending machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the second bench on the right from the entrance, near the drinks machine rather than the noticeboard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置がよくわかりました。鍵をお預かりします。確認が必要になった場合のため、連絡先も伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The location is clear. We will receive the key. May I also have contact details in case we need to confirm anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、この携帯番号でお願いします。仕事中は出られないことがあるので、着信を確認したら折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯番号を伝え、勤務中は出られないことがあるが着信確認後に折り返すと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please use this mobile number. Sometimes I cannot answer at work, but I will call back after checking the missed call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your mobile number, explaining you may not answer while working but will return the call after seeing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先を記録しました。受付の控えをお渡しします。お届けいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have recorded your contact details. Here is a receipt for the report. Thank you for bringing it in. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居先への郵便についてですね。新しいお住まいの住所は、建物名と部屋番号までわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about mail at your new home. Do you know the full address, including building name and room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この契約書の三〇一号室です。郵便受けには前の住人の名前が残っていますが、そのままでも自分の手紙は届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書の三〇一号室を示し、郵便受けに前住人の名前があるままでも届くか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Room301 on this contract. The previous tenant's name is still on the mailbox; will my letters arrive if it stays that way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point to room301 in the contract and ask whether mail arrives with the former resident's name still displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部屋番号と名前の表示が違うと、確認が必要になることがあります。ご自分の名前の札に替えられるか、管理者にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the room number and displayed name differ, verification may be needed. Ask the manager whether you can change the nameplate to your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 管理者に聞いてから札を替えます。契約書では名前がローマ字ですが、札も同じローマ字で書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理者へ確認して札を替えると伝え、契約書どおりローマ字で名前を書けばよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will ask the manager before changing it. My name is in Roman letters on the contract; should I write it that way on the plate too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the manager before changing the plate and ask about using Roman letters as in the contract. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便物に書かれる名前と対応がわかる表示にしてください。普段カタカナでも郵便を受け取るなら、両方書いておくと確認しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use a display that can be matched to the name on mail. If you also receive mail in katakana, writing both will make checks easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社からの手紙はカタカナなので、ローマ字と両方書きます。古い住所へ届く手紙の手続とは、別のことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の手紙はカタカナなので両表記にすると伝え、旧住所からの転送手続とは別か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Letters from my company use katakana, so I will write both it and Roman letters. Is this separate from the procedure for letters going to my old address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say company mail uses katakana so you will display both, and ask whether that is separate from forwarding from the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、郵便受けの表示を替えるだけでは、旧住所からの転送の申込みにはなりません。転居の手続は、こちらの案内で方法をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, changing the mailbox display alone is not a forwarding application from the old address. Check the relocation procedure in this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 札だけ替えても転送されないのですね。旧住所も新住所も書いたメモがありますが、この内容を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 札の交換だけでは転送されないと確認し、新旧住所のメモを見てもらう。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So changing the plate alone does not forward mail. I have a note with both addresses; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that changing the plate does not forward mail and show a note of both addresses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。新住所の三〇一号室まで記載されていますね。申込みでは本人確認もありますので、案内に記載された必要な物をご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the new address includes room301. The application also requires identity verification, so prepare the required items listed in the guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所のメモを残して、必要な物を確認してから申し込みます。郵便受けの札は管理者に確認し、二つの名前の表記を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要物を確認して転居手続を申し込み、札は管理者に確認してローマ字とカタカナを記すと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the address note and apply after checking what is needed. For the mailbox plate, I will ask the manager and include both versions of my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check required items and apply, then ask the manager and put Roman letters and katakana on the plate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのように進めてください。こちらが手続の案内です。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed that way. Here is the procedure guide. Thank you for consulting us today. Take care on your way home.
